value: CASL is preferred on RMSE because this thesis prioritises large-error / extreme-anomaly risk. RMSE penalises the large misses that matter most for drought and flood-relevant groundwater extremes, and CASL attains the lowest test RMSE of all models. RF attains the lowest test MAE and wins the most individual wells, so it is the stronger typical-month / central-tendency model, but its higher RMSE means it is comparatively worse on the rare large-deviation events that this work targets. The two are reported together rather than treating RF's per-well count or MAE lead as a refutation of CASL.
